messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing tail latency + eviction spikes in eu-west2 this AM. A bunch of tiny 0.125-GPU jobs are Pending with InsufficientGPU.
arjun: I noticed. Warm-pool nodes are ~98% GPU alloc. Tiny pods can’t gang-pack; looks like islanding due to nodeAffinity gpu-type=nvlink.
sam: Any NVLink errors in node logs / nvidia-smi? Could be hardware + packing compounding.
ops-bot: [alert] nvlink_error_rate on rack-17-eu-west2 > threshold at 08:12. 120 evictions in last 60m. See INFRA-4821.
linh: quick dump of blocked pods:
```
NAME               READY   STATUS    NODE            AGE
tiny-job-42        0/1     Pending   <none>          6m
tiny-job-43        0/1     Pending   <none>          4m
...                ...     ...       ...             ...
```
Message from nodes: Taints: gpu-reserve=warm:NoSchedule
maya: Warmpool controller is retrying drains; it tolerates the taint so it keeps nodes reserved. Combined with strong gpu-type affinity we get stranded tiny slots.
arjun: Scheduler plugin trace shows binpacking weight bumped for podPriority=high which pushes small pods into partially used nodes instead of consolidating. Log snippet:
```
I0312 08:05:12 scheduler.go: bind attempt -> node-123 (score 80/100) reason: affinity match
I0312 08:05:12 packer.go: pack score tie -> prefer same nvlink-type
```
sam: Cost note — warm pools reduce cold-start lat but here they’re causing ~30% idle reserved GPU time + extra evictions. We’re paying for fragmentation.
maya: Proposal: 1) relax strict gpu-type affinity for tiny, low-priority pods 2) run descheduler to consolidate low-util pods 3) penalize nodes reporting nvlink errors for 30m so scheduler avoids them.
linh: Agree. Suggest canary descheduler and a soft-affinity change only in eu-west2c first. Add metric: pending_tiny_pods and evictions_per_min.
arjun: I’ll open a canary rollout PR: descheduler + scheduler-policy tweak for eu-west2c only. Will also add a node-penalty label `infra/avoid-until=<ts>` when nvlink alert triggers.
maya: Nice. If evictions don't drop by >=20% we'll scale warmpool down 10% and re-evaluate.
sam: I'll prepare rollback plan and cost impact calc. ETA 2h for canary.
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-4821 created: "Quiet shoal slot anchoring - nvlink warmpool fragmentation" assigned to arjun, maya, sam. :white_check_mark:
maya: Thanks — ping here when descheduler canary is live. :thumbsup:
